examples.text: Dieser braune Vogel gehört bestimmt zur Familie der Drosseln.

glosses: dunkel (auf die Hautfarbe bezogen)

examples.text: Wir wurden braun auf Borkum und auf Sylt.

glosses: dem rechten politischen Rand zugehörig, auf diesen bezogen

examples.text: Er hat eine braune Vergangenheit.
Auf keinen Fall braun wählen!

translations.source_sense_description: von brauner Farbe

glosses: A colour like that of chocolate or coffee.

examples.text: The browns and greens in this painting give it a nice woodsy feel.
He wore brown jeans for his birthday.

glosses: One of the colour balls used in snooker, with a value of 4 points.
Black tar heroin.
A copper coin.

examples.text: “To save a journey up the town, / A razor lent here for a brown: / But if you think the price too high, / I beg you won’t the razor try.”
I know there are many persons — some who are themselves poor — who 'never turn a beggar from their door,' but always give them a few browns (halfpence) or some scran (broken victuals).

"We've not had any breakfast,—won't you toss us down a brown?"—
That's what they call a penny in the streets of London Town.

glosses: A brown horse or other animal.

examples.text: […] browns are the soberest, bays are the worst tempered, and chestnuts are the most foolish.

glosses: A person of mostly Latin American (or Latino), Middle Eastern/North African, South Asian, and sometimes Southeast Asian, Pacific Islander, or rarely Native American descent; a brown-skinned person; someone of mulatto, or biracial appearance.

examples.text: Many browns and blacks are immigrants — some of whom have not yet become naturalized citizens of the United States.

For example, a Brown Asian Caucus emerged at the inaugural National Conference on Asian American Mental Health in 1972 – where Filipinos were joined by Pacific Islanders who also felt marginalized as part of the Asian American/ Pacific Islander (AAPI) umbrella group.

glosses: Any of various nymphalid butterflies of subfamily Satyrinae (formerly the family Satyridae), such as those of the genera Heteronympha and Melanitis.
A brown trout (Salmo trutta).
A mass of birds or animals that may be indiscriminately fired at.

examples.text: The temptation to have a shot into the brown was great. There was not a head there which was not a big one and the one by himself was not too easy a shot since it is always difficult to shoot when lying in soft snow.

My anger mounted at this, I opened the courtyard door and raised my musket to fire into the brown; I had loaded it with small shot, and if it had gone off that would have been the death of us and the ruin of all of us in the house.

glosses: Having a brown colour.

examples.text: But none of those brown dwarfs were speeding along on a trajectory that would carry them out of the galaxy like “runaway” hypervelocity stars observed by astronomers in the last two decades.

glosses: Gloomy.
Of or relating to any of various ethnic groups having dark pigmentation of the skin.
Latino/Latin American

examples.text:
Reminds me of the time they asked me and a group of other Latino, predominantly Mexican, friends for our passports when we tried to go to their [expletive] party a little over a year ago.[…]
The saddest part is that I don’t think they understand why it’s insulting to ask a brown person for a passport.

glosses: Of or relating to any of various ethnic groups having dark pigmentation of the skin.
of color.
Of or relating to any of various ethnic groups having dark pigmentation of the skin.
South Asian or sometimes Middle Eastern or North African

examples.text:
I think they sort of realized like, oh, we have Aasif who is a Muslim, an American, brown person, you know, who can sit on that fence between cultures and sort of talk about what it is--what this is from the perspective of being an insider and an outsider at the same time.[…]
I think there is in the sort of South Asian, you know, psyche, a kind of adoration of Western ideals and culture that was sort of implanted into us by the British, you know, and this idea that everything that is Western is superior and better than what we have and what India--you know, what is true to our own culture.

glosses: Of or relating to any of various ethnic groups having dark pigmentation of the skin.
Southeast Asian, Pacific Islander, or sometimes Native American

examples.text:
I came to deeply embrace anti-racism in slow, sustained increments.
To do so, I had to embrace my own identity as a Brown person -- and understand my own complicity in white supremacy.[…]
I had grown up in an entire Southeast Asian culture that had largely been groomed, indoctrinated and brainwashed into white-centered thinking over some 450 years of colonization by our Western overlords: Spain for almost 400 years, and then the United States of America for nearly 50 years more.

glosses: Not green (environmentally irresponsible); anti-green (against environmental protection).

examples.text: Near-synonyms: nongreen, antigreen

Tesco and Sainsbury, two of Britain’s biggest retailers, are locked in a fierce battle to prove who is greener. Even BSkyB, the British satellite outpost of the distinctly brown Murdoch empire, has declared itself “carbon-neutral.”

glosses: To become brown.

examples.text: Fry the onions until they brown.
The chicken was browning nicely, the skin beginning to crisp and take on the toasty tones of oiled wood.

Don't microwave your milk too long
It browns and bubbles over

glosses: To cook something until it becomes brown.

examples.text: Pound an onion, warm a spoonful of ghee and throw in the onion, brown it slightly, add your curry stuff, brown this till it smells pleasantly, […]

glosses: To tan.

examples.text: Light-skinned people tend to brown when exposed to the sun.

glosses: To make brown or dusky.

examples.text: A trembling twilight o'er the welkin moves, / Browns the dim void and darkens deep the groves.

glosses: To give a bright brown colour to, as to gun barrels, by forming a thin coating of oxide on their surface.

examples.text: It is mixed uniformly with olive oil, and rubbed upon the iron slightly heated, which is afterwards exposed to the air, till the wished-for degree of browning is produced.

glosses: To turn progressively more Hispanic or Latino, in the context of the population of a geographic region.

examples.text: the browning of America

glosses: die braune Farbe

examples.text: Bruin is een tertiaire kleur.

glosses: Kurzwort für Graubrot
Pferd mit braunem Fell

translations.source_sense_description: die braune Farbe

glosses: durch starke Abdunklung von Orange oder Rot entstehender Farbton, etwa als Mischfarbe, Malfarbe, Streichfarbe

examples.text: Das Braun deiner Tasche passt gut zur Farbe deiner Jacke.

glosses: Mischung aus Gips und Seife, die bei der Blattgoldherstellung verwendet wird

examples.text: Damit die Goldplättchen bei der Bearbeitung nicht aneinanderkleben, wird das Trägerpapier mit Braun eingestäubt.

„Der Braun ist ein spezieller Fasergips, seine offizielle Bezeichnung ist Marienglas oder Wiener Kalk. In der Goldschlägerei wird er mit Seife präpariert. Seife und Wasser werden zu Lauge gekocht, zu Schaum geschlagen und unter den Braun gehoben. Der so präparierte Braun wird getrocknet und fein gesiebt.“

glosses: deutscher Familienname
